title: 1 Old Downs Road, Willow Grove, Delgany, Co. Wicklow, A63PX04
seoTitle: 1 Old Downs Road, Willow Grove, Delgany, Co. Wicklow, A63PX04
description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors welcome you to this exceptional home set in a wonderful sylvan setting at the gateway to the garden of Ireland, this woodland setting is hard to beat with stunning woodland walks virtually on your doorstep. The N11/M11 is just minutes away providing speedy access to all Wicklow has to offer from bustling towns, to coast amenities plus the mountains. The area is served by Bus Eireann services taking commuters to Greystones, Bray and Dublin City Centre. One visit to the Glen of the Downs and it is immediately evident why the inhabitants fought so hard to preserve this magnificent natural amenity. This stunning home has been meticulously upgraded and maintained by the current owners creating an inviting home that is ready for immediate occupation. This is a one of a kind home that provides a wonderful combination of quality construction, generous accommodation, excellent upgrades and an enviable location. There is a fresh modern interior which is ideally suited to a purchaser in search of a home ready for immediate occupation. On approach this property immediately catches the eye with access via a sweeping driveway, the accommodation is thoughtfully arranged and offers excellent flexibility for modern family living. Nicely positioned on envious gardens extending to 0.33 acres the the inside is equally as impressive as outside, number 1 comprises 175 square metres of accommodation in pristine condition, once inside you canï¿½t fail to be impressive, the entrance hallway sets the tone perfectly and leads one to a wonderful living room overlooking the front garden, following through to the real heart of the home, a truly special kitchen diner, here bespoke cabinetry is home to quality integrated Bosch appliances and the dual aspect windows and doors bring the outside inside beautifully and flood the room with natural light. A real highlight of this property is the sunroom located just off the kitchen diner, flooded with natural light, this is a wonderful bright and airy space that offers an ideal location for relaxing with a coffee or glass of wine, or a space to simply sit back and enjoy the outlook over the truly stunning gardens. At ground floor level a sumptuous primary bedroom suite is truly a delight with a luxurious ensuite, a further bedroom plus a shower room complete the downstairs accommodation. Rising to the upper floor via a custom built staircase, there are two further rooms each with luxurious ensuite, once even including a jacuzzi bath. Outside the mature gardens that surround this home are lush with thoughtfully planted trees and shrubs, to the front there is ample parking, while the rear is home to extensive lawns and play areas teamed with a wonderful patio area adjoining the house creating a superl outdoor dining room perfect for al fresco dining. A large timber garden house with plumbing and electricity is perfect for a variety of uses from additional guest accommodation to home office to home gym. 
Old Downs Road lies just of the N11 with the picturesque village of Delgany, which is widely regarded as one of Ireland's most charming villages boasting first class dining options with renowned restaurants, cafes and cosy pubs close at hand. The attractive seaside town of Greystones is just a little further and again provides access to an array of services, amenities and sporting facilities. Viewing of this stunning home is highly recommended to truly appreciate all it has to offer.

Accommodation 

A cosy composite front door creates an attractive statement while keeping this home warm and secure, the entrance hallway sets the tone perfect with a welcoming approach via this hallway with warm oak timber flooring at foot and coved ceilings overhead. An internal hallway features attractive large cream porcelain tiles while a bespoke custom built timber staircase rises to the upper level. 

Living Room/Bedroom 2
A wonderful bright family room overlooking the front garden with warm solid oak timber flooring and attractive decor creating an inviting atmosphere. 

Kitchen Diner 
5.5 x 4.8m 
This bright super spacious family kitchen boasts dual aspect windows and doors flooding the room with natural light, this is a truly special room and is home to an excellent range of bespoke hand crafted cabinetry in a contemporary two tone featuring high gloss units and oak units, high quality integrated Bosch appliances provide all you could possibly need teamed with a handy tap providing instant boiling water or cold filtered water. The kitchen area is complete with extensive stunning countertops with matching splashback perfect for ease of maintenance. A wonderful breakfast bar has plenty of room for four stools, the ideal place to grab a quick bite to eat or coffee. Double doors open out to the rear garden while a further set of doors lead to the sunroom. 

Sunroom
This is a real highlight of this property, flooded with natural light, this is a wonderful bright and airy space that offers an ideal location for relaxing with a coffee or glass of wine, or a space to simply sit back and enjoy the outlook over the truly stunning gardens. Sliding doors lead to a wonderful patio area with a sunny southerly aspect. 

Primary Bedroom 
4.9 x 3.2m 
This sumptuous primary suite is bathed in natural light and provides generous bedroom accommodation with a luxurious ensuite shower room boasting extensive tiling creating that hotel quality and luxury, with his and hers wash hand basins with with vanity units below and above providing ample bathroom storage, wc, large shower area and chrome plated heated towel rail. 

Bedroom 3
2.2 x 3.6m 

Shower Room
With high quality sanitary ware including wc, wash hand basin and shower cubicle home to a Triton T90z electric shower unit, attractive mosaic tiling is featured on the walls while the floor is also tiled. 

Upstairs: 
Most attractive custom built staircase rises to the upper level with a bright spacious landing area flooded with natural light from a south facing skylight overhead. Generous storage cupboards here provide additional storage. 

Room 1
5.3 x 5m 
Flooded with natural light from three velux windows overhead, featuring polished pine floorboard and built in wardrobes. The eaves area provides additional storage also. Stunning luxury ensuite bathroom with wc, wash hand basin with vanity unit, jacuzzi bath and attractive mosaic tiled walls and floor. 

Room 2
5.6 x 5m 
Again bathed in natural light from the skylight windows overhead, this spacious room features polished pine floorboards, a good range of built-in wardrobes, shelving units plus a vanity desk. Ensuite shower room with wc, wash hand basin and large double shower tray with glazed screen, feature mosaic wall tiling, tiled floor plus a chrome plated heated towel rail. 


Outside 
Set well back from the road, the property sits nicely on gardens extending to 0.33 acres, with access via a pillared approach leading to a spacious gravelled forecourt offering plenty of off street parking and a circulating area, mature hedging provides super screening and privacy. To the rear is a truly super garden boasting an envious southerly aspect. Directly off the sunroom lies a wonderful patio area creating an outdoor dining room perfect for al fresco dining and barbeques on summers evenings. The setting is idyllic and tranquil, a peaceful haven to sit back and relax. An extensive lawned area is set just above the patio area, while a gravelled pathway leads to the garden house, the way is bordered by well stocked raised flowerbed adding a splash of colour throughout the year. A super play area lies beyond the lawns, here the current owners have created a wonderful safe environment for children to play. At the bottom of the garden lies a truly spectacular timber garden house with power and water supply making it perfect for a variety of uses depending on your needs, this could provide additional accommodation or a wonderful home office away from the hustle and bustle of the main house.
